Appreciate the doc and summary. We're happy to proceed. Quick operational notes and internal asks so we can align before the DocuSign:

4) Compliance & telemetry: Our marketplace requires partner SSO assertion for admin actions and KMS-backed keying for the code pool. If Zephyr prefers, we can rotate the pool keys monthly — this affects expiration and reporting windows.

I'll coordinate DocuSign with Marcus once we have the approver and billing guidance. Tagging Jordan to scope any analytics tagging/filters for the Dashboard so Zephyr can see redemptions by account and region.

Thanks — will follow up after Marcus signs.
